definitions.text: holde innsatsen, kraften eller prestasjonene ved like
definitions.translation: maintain effort, power, or performance (lit. keep the steam up)

examples.no: legevakten må holde dampen oppe i ferien
examples.en: the emergency clinic has to keep up the pace during the holiday

examples.no: laget holdt dampen oppe gjennom hele turneringen
examples.en: the team kept up the pace throughout the tournament
